_comment: Reduced Astra example egg (Paper), PTDL_v2 structure. Minecraft EULA must be accepted by the server owner (eula.txt).
name: Minecraft Paper
author: astra@example.invalid
description: Paper is a high performance Minecraft server fork of Spigot. Accept the Minecraft EULA by setting eula=true in eula.txt after the first start (Files tab or console).

installation.script:
#!/bin/bash
# Paper Installation Script (PaperMC Fill v3)
# Server Files: /mnt/server
# Bricht bei jedem Fehler ab (Exit != 0), damit der Install nie still "ready" meldet.
set -euo pipefail

apt-get update -qq
apt-get install -y -qq curl jq unzip ca-certificates

mkdir -p /mnt/server
cd /mnt/server

PROJECT=paper
API="https://fill.papermc.io/v3/projects/${PROJECT}"
SERVER_JARFILE="${SERVER_JARFILE:-server.jar}"
MINECRAFT_VERSION="${MINECRAFT_VERSION:-latest}"
BUILD_NUMBER="${BUILD_NUMBER:-latest}"
DL_PATH="${DL_PATH:-}"

fail() { echo "ERROR: $*" >&2; exit 1; }
# Fill v3 expects a descriptive User-Agent; generic clients may be rejected
UA="astra-panel-installer/1.0 (+https://github.com/sincs99/astra)"
fetch() { curl -fsSL -A "${UA}" --retry 3 --retry-delay 2 --connect-timeout 15 --max-time 300 "$@"; }

TMP_JAR=$(mktemp /mnt/server/.download.XXXXXX)
trap 'rm -f "${TMP_JAR}"' EXIT

EXPECTED_SHA=""
if [ -n "${DL_PATH}" ]; then
    # {{MINECRAFT_VERSION}} und {{BUILD_NUMBER}} im eigenen Link werden ersetzt (kein eval)
    DOWNLOAD_URL="${DL_PATH//\{\{MINECRAFT_VERSION\}\}/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}}"
    DOWNLOAD_URL="${DOWNLOAD_URL//\{\{BUILD_NUMBER\}\}/${BUILD_NUMBER}}"
    case "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" in
        http://*|https://*) ;;
        *) fail "Download Path must be an http(s) URL" ;;
    esac
    echo "Using supplied download url: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
else
    PROJECT_JSON=$(fetch "${API}") || fail "Could not reach the PaperMC API (${API})"
    # Fill v3 liefert die Versionen nach Hauptversion gruppiert; alle stabilen Versionen einsammeln, Vorabversionen weglassen
    VERSIONS=$(echo "${PROJECT_JSON}" | jq -r '[(.versions // []) | if type == "object" then (to_entries[] | .value[]) else .[] end]
        | map(select(test("^[0-9]+(\\.[0-9]+)*$"))) | .[]' | sort -V) || fail "Unexpected response from the PaperMC API"
    LATEST_VERSION=$(echo "${VERSIONS}" | tail -n 1)
    [ -n "${LATEST_VERSION}" ] || fail "The PaperMC API returned no versions"

    # Kanal (nur fuer "latest"): ALPHA < BETA < STABLE. Es zaehlt der gewuenschte oder ein stabilerer Kanal.
    BUILD_CHANNEL=$(echo "${BUILD_CHANNEL:-STABLE}" | tr '[:lower:]' '[:upper:]' | tr -d '[:space:]')
    case "${BUILD_CHANNEL}" in
        STABLE) MIN_RANK=3 ;;
        BETA) MIN_RANK=2 ;;
        ALPHA) MIN_RANK=1 ;;
        *) fail "BUILD_CHANNEL must be STABLE, BETA or ALPHA (got '${BUILD_CHANNEL}')" ;;
    esac
    RANK='def rank: ({"ALPHA":1,"BETA":2,"STABLE":3,"RECOMMENDED":3}[((.channel // "ALPHA") | tostring | ascii_upcase)] // 1);'
    # Neuester Build mit mindestens dem Rang $1 aus einer Build-Liste (stdin); leere Ausgabe, wenn es keinen gibt
    newest_build() {
        jq -c --argjson min "$1" "${RANK}"' [(if type == "array" then . else (.builds // []) end)[] | select(rank >= $min)] | sort_by(.id) | last // empty'
    }
    # Liste der Builds einer Version laden und den neuesten Build im gewuenschten Kanal (oder stabiler) liefern
    build_in_channel() {
        local list
        list=$(fetch "${API}/versions/$1/builds") || return 1
        echo "${list}" | newest_build "${MIN_RANK}"
    }

    BUILD_JSON=""
    if [ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" != "latest" ] && [ -n "${BUILD_NUMBER}" ] && ! [[ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        echo "Build number '${BUILD_NUMBER}' is not a number. Using the newest ${BUILD_CHANNEL} build."
    fi
    IS_LATEST_VERSION=false
    if [ "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" = "latest" ] || [ -z "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}" ]; then IS_LATEST_VERSION=true; fi
    if ${IS_LATEST_VERSION} && ! [[ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
        # Neueste Version nehmen, die einen Build im Kanal (oder stabiler) hat; fehlt er (z.B. Hauptversion nur als BETA), eine aeltere
        for CANDIDATE in $(echo "${VERSIONS}" | sort -rV | head -n 20); do
            if BUILD_JSON=$(build_in_channel "${CANDIDATE}") && [ -n "${BUILD_JSON}" ]; then
                MINECRAFT_VERSION="${CANDIDATE}"
                break
            fi
            BUILD_JSON=""
            echo "Version ${CANDIDATE} has no ${BUILD_CHANNEL} build yet (or it could not be loaded), trying an older version"
        done
        [ -n "${BUILD_JSON}" ] || fail "No ${PROJECT} version with a ${BUILD_CHANNEL} (or more stable) build found"
        echo "Using the latest ${PROJECT} version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} with a ${BUILD_CHANNEL} build"
    else
        if ${IS_LATEST_VERSION}; then
            # feste Build-Nummer ohne feste Version: neueste Version (die Nummer gilt unabhaengig vom Kanal)
            MINECRAFT_VERSION="${LATEST_VERSION}"
            echo "Using the latest ${PROJECT} version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
        elif echo "${VERSIONS}" | grep -Fxq -- "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"; then
            echo "Version is valid. Using version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
        else
            echo "Specified version '${MINECRAFT_VERSION}' not found. Defaulting to the latest ${PROJECT} version ${LATEST_VERSION}"
            MINECRAFT_VERSION="${LATEST_VERSION}"
        fi
        if [[ "${BUILD_NUMBER}" =~ ^[0-9]+$ ]]; then
            # Eine feste Build-Nummer gilt unabhaengig vom Kanal
            if ! BUILD_JSON=$(fetch "${API}/versions/${MINECRAFT_VERSION}/builds/${BUILD_NUMBER}"); then
                echo "Build ${BUILD_NUMBER} not found for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}. Using the newest ${BUILD_CHANNEL} build."
                BUILD_JSON=""
            fi
        fi
        if [ -z "${BUILD_JSON}" ]; then
            BUILD_JSON=$(build_in_channel "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}") || fail "Could not load the builds for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
            if [ -z "${BUILD_JSON}" ]; then
                echo "WARNING: version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} has no ${BUILD_CHANNEL} build, using its newest build of any channel"
                MIN_RANK=1
                BUILD_JSON=$(build_in_channel "${MINECRAFT_VERSION}") || fail "Could not load the builds for version ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
            fi
        fi
        [ -n "${BUILD_JSON}" ] || fail "No build found for ${PROJECT} ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    fi

    BUILD_ID=$(echo "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.id // empty')
    CHANNEL=$(echo "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.channel // "unknown"')
    DOWNLOAD_URL=$(echo "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].url // empty')
    EXPECTED_SHA=$(echo "${BUILD_JSON}" | jq -r '.downloads["server:default"].checksums.sha256 // empty')
    [ -n "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" ] || fail "No server download found for ${PROJECT} ${MINECRAFT_VERSION} build ${BUILD_ID:-?}"
    echo "Version being downloaded"
    echo "MC Version: ${MINECRAFT_VERSION}"
    echo "Build: ${BUILD_ID:-unknown} (channel ${CHANNEL})"
fi

echo "Downloading ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"
fetch -o "${TMP_JAR}" "${DOWNLOAD_URL}" || fail "Download failed: ${DOWNLOAD_URL}"

# Der Download muss ein echtes Jar (ZIP) sein, nie eine Fehlerseite
[ -s "${TMP_JAR}" ] || fail "Downloaded file is empty"
[ "$(head -c 2 "${TMP_JAR}")" = "PK" ] || fail "Downloaded file is not a jar (no ZIP header): $(head -c 120 "${TMP_JAR}" | tr -d '\r\n')"
unzip -tq "${TMP_JAR}" >/dev/null || fail "Downloaded jar is corrupt"
if [ -n "${EXPECTED_SHA}" ]; then
    ACTUAL_SHA=$(sha256sum "${TMP_JAR}" | cut -d ' ' -f 1)
    [ "${ACTUAL_SHA}" = "${EXPECTED_SHA}" ] || fail "Checksum mismatch (expected ${EXPECTED_SHA}, got ${ACTUAL_SHA})"
    echo "Checksum OK (sha256)"
fi

if [ -f "${SERVER_JARFILE}" ]; then
    mv "${SERVER_JARFILE}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}.old"
fi
mv "${TMP_JAR}" "${SERVER_JARFILE}"
chmod 644 "${SERVER_JARFILE}"

if [ ! -f server.properties ]; then
    echo "Downloading MC server.properties"
    fetch -o server.properties https://raw.githubusercontent.com/parkervcp/eggs/master/minecraft/java/server.properties \
        || { rm -f server.properties; echo "WARNING: server.properties could not be downloaded, the server creates its own on first start."; }
fi
echo "Install complete. Accept the Minecraft EULA by setting eula=true in eula.txt after the first start."

variables.name: Minecraft Version
variables.description: The version of Minecraft to download. Leave at latest to get the newest version.

variables.name: Server Jar File
variables.description: The name of the server jarfile to run the server with.

variables.name: Download Path
variables.description: A URL to use to download a server.jar rather than the default PaperMC build.

variables.name: Build Number
variables.description: The Paper build number. Leave at latest to get the newest build.

variables.name: Build Channel
variables.description: Release channel used when Minecraft Version or Build Number is 'latest': STABLE (default), BETA or ALPHA. A newer build of the same or a more stable channel wins. A fixed build number ignores the channel.
